## Motivation

SemiAnalysis InferenceX requires every SGLang submission's production configuration, including the router and the prefill/decode launch commands of a disaggregated deployment, to be documented in the SGLang cookbook before the InferenceX PR merges. This adds that documentation for an AMD MI355X submission, `glm5.2-fp4-mi355x-infera-sglang-agentic-disagg` ([InferenceX #4629](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4629), draft): `amd/GLM-5.2-MXFP4` served as prefill/decode disaggregation behind [Infera](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Infera)'s KV-aware router.

The workers are SGLang's own server. Infera's launcher (`python3 -m infera.engine.sglang`) forwards every SGLang flag unchanged and registers the worker in etcd; the router discovers workers there, routes prefill on the cached prefix each worker reports through SGLang's ZMQ KV events, keeps a session on one prefill worker, and balances decode DP ranks. This is the same split as the Dynamo entries on this page (a deployment layer in front of `sglang.launch_server` flags), and it follows the hand-written MI355X PD section of the DeepSeek-V4 page (§3.7) rather than the generated AgentX block, which covers NVIDIA submissions.

**Draft** until:
- Infera 0.3.2 is published with the `infera-router` binary in its wheel, the router's `--decode-request-weight`, and [AMD-AGI/Infera#222](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Infera/pull/222) (the worker advertises a caller-supplied `--kv-events-config` port);
- the deployment is re-run on the stock image below with these commands;

## Modifications

`docs/cookbook/autoregressive/GLM/GLM-5.2.mdx`: new **§3.6 PD Disaggregation on MI355X with the Infera Router**:
- image (`lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.22-rocm720-mi35x-20261018`), RDMA container flags and the Infera install (`--no-deps`, so the image's packages are untouched);
- the three shapes (1P1D with an 8-GPU decode, 1P with a 4-GPU decode, 2P1D), with TP1 × PP4 prefill, write-back HiCache at 250 GB per stage, TP + DP-attention decode and EAGLE 5-1-6 on both roles;
- etcd, shared environment, prefill, decode and router commands in launch order;
- why `--disable-custom-all-reduce`, `--disable-overlap-schedule`, `MC_MAX_MR_SIZE` and the HiCache size matter here;
- a note listing the open SGLang fixes the stock image still needs for this deployment: #21194 / #47184 (PP stages without the embedding), #46830 and #33059 (DP-attention decode on gfx950), #46820 (KV-metrics backpressure).

Excluded as InferenceX-only harness settings: simulated MTP acceptance (`SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_*`) and the benchmark client's environment.

## Accuracy Tests

Docs only. The configuration was measured with these flags on an MI355X image that carries the fixes above: GSM8K 0.9666 (strict) / 0.9674 (flexible) on 1P1D with real MTP acceptance. A run on the stock image is pending (see Draft).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Docs only. On that image, AgentX (3,600 s per point, simulated acceptance 3.61): 1P1D 31,088 tok/s/GPU at C88, 1P + 4-GPU decode 37,310 at C80, 2P1D 38,392 at C176. InferenceX will publish its own measurement.

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). (not run; docs-only change)
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). (docs only)
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (stock-image run pending)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

files.patch:
@@ -348,3 +348,126 @@ When deploying with PD Disaggregation, the prefill node can choose to enable [La
 --cp-strategy interleave \
 ```
 With LayerSplit, the kv cache on each rank can be sharded over the CP attention group, and prefetched when necessary. This can reduce kv cache memory by up to 75%, thus increasing the throughput on prefill side.
+
+### 3.6 PD Disaggregation on MI355X with the Infera Router
+
+This deployment serves `amd/GLM-5.2-MXFP4` on MI355X as prefill/decode disaggregation behind [Infera](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Infera)'s KV-aware router, for agentic multi-turn traffic. Each worker is SGLang's own server (`sglang.launch_server`), started through Infera's launcher `python3 -m infera.engine.sglang`, which forwards every SGLang flag unchanged and registers the worker in etcd. The router discovers the workers there, scores prefill workers by the cached prefix each one holds (it reads SGLang's ZMQ KV events), keeps a session on one prefill worker, and balances decode DP ranks by booked tokens and held requests. It is the configuration submitted to SemiAnalysis InferenceX AgentX as `glm5.2-fp4-mi355x-infera-sglang-agentic-disagg`.
+
+<Note>
+The PP4 prefill needs [#47184](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/47184): without it every pipeline stage that does not own the embedding fails at model construction. Decode with DP attention on gfx950 needs [#46830](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46830) and [#33059](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/33059), and kv-aware routing needs [#46820](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46820). Until an image includes them, apply them on top of the image below.
+</Note>
+
+**Image and install.** Run every process in `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.22-rocm720-mi35x-20261018` with the RDMA NICs passed in (`--device /dev/infiniband`, `--cap-add IPC_LOCK`, `--ulimit memlock=-1`, `--network host --ipc=host`, on top of the ROCm device flags from the [Install panel](#install)). Infera is not in the image; install it without touching the image's packages (only `nats-py` is missing from it):
+
+```bash Command
+pip install --no-deps nats-py==2.16.0 amd-infera==0.3.2 \
+  --find-links https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Infera/releases/expanded_assets/v0.3.2
+```
+
+**Shapes.** The prefill worker is TP1 × PP4 on four GPUs with write-back HiCache; decode runs TP + DP attention. MTP is EAGLE 5-1-6 on both roles, so the KV transfer includes the draft layer.
+
+| Shape | Prefill | Decode | GPUs | Router `--decode-request-weight` |
+|---|---|---|---|---|
+| 1P1D | 1 × TP1·PP4 | TP8, DP-attention 8 | 12 | `1000000` |
+| 1P + 4-GPU decode | 1 × TP1·PP4 | TP4, DP-attention 4 | 8 | `0` |
+| 2P1D | 2 × TP1·PP4 on one node | TP8, DP-attention 8 | 16 | `0` |
+
+Start the processes in this order: etcd, the prefill worker(s), the decode worker, then the router. `$ETCD_IP` is the etcd host, `$NODE_IP` the worker's own routable address, and `$NIC` its network interface. A second prefill worker on the same node uses `HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=4,5,6,7` and different `--port`, `--disaggregation-bootstrap-port` and KV-events ports.
+
+**etcd:**
+
+```bash Command
+etcd --data-dir /tmp/etcd \
+  --listen-client-urls http://0.0.0.0:2379 \
+  --advertise-client-urls http://$ETCD_IP:2379
+```
+
+**Environment for both roles:**
+
+```bash Command
+export GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME=$NIC NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=$NIC NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1 NCCL_IGNORE_CPU_AFFINITY=1
+export HSA_NO_SCRATCH_RECLAIM=1 HIP_FORCE_DEV_KERNARG=1 SAFETENSORS_FAST_GPU=1 PYTHONHASHSEED=0
+export AITER_USE_FLYDSL_MOE_SORTING=1 SGLANG_DP_USE_GATHERV=1
+export SGLANG_OPT_USE_TOPK_V2=true SGLANG_OPT_USE_JIT_KERNEL_GROUPED_TOPK=0
+export SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_BOOTSTRAP_TIMEOUT=1800 SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_WAITING_TIMEOUT=1800
+export SGLANG_TIMEOUT_KEEP_ALIVE=900 INFERA_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT=3600
+# Mooncake: RDMA across nodes, the same rail on both ends, 1 GiB memory regions on ionic.
+export MC_DISABLE_HIP=1 MC_GID_INDEX=1 MC_ENABLE_DEST_DEVICE_AFFINITY=1 MC_MAX_MR_SIZE=1073741824 RDMAV_FORK_SAFE=1
+```
+
+**Prefill (TP1 × PP4, layers 20/20/20/18):**
+
+```bash Command
+HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3 \
+SGLANG_PP_LAYER_PARTITION=20,20,20,18 \
+SGLANG_HICACHE_HOST_REGISTER_CHUNK_GB=512 \
+python3 -m infera.engine.sglang \
+  --discovery-backend etcd --etcd-endpoint http://$ETCD_IP:2379 \
+  --advertise-host $NODE_IP --request-transport http --kv-event-transport zmq --kv-events off \
+  --model-path amd/GLM-5.2-MXFP4 --served-model-name amd/GLM-5.2-MXFP4 --trust-remote-code \
+  --host 0.0.0.0 --port 30000 \
+  --disaggregation-mode prefill --disaggregation-bootstrap-port 8998 \
+  --disaggregation-transfer-backend mooncake \
+  --disaggregation-ib-device rdma0,rdma1,rdma2,rdma3,rdma4,rdma5,rdma6,rdma7 \
+  --kv-events-config '{"publisher":"zmq","topic":"kv-events","endpoint":"tcp://*:5557"}' \
+  --tp-size 1 --pp-size 4 --ep-size 1 --disable-overlap-schedule \
+  --chunked-prefill-size 8192 --max-prefill-tokens 8192 --mem-fraction-static 0.88 \
+  --schedule-policy shortest-prefill-first \
+  --enable-hierarchical-cache --hicache-size 250 --hicache-ratio 1.5 \
+  --hicache-write-policy write_back --hicache-io-backend kernel --hicache-mem-layout page_first \
+  --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 --dsa-prefill-backend triton --dsa-decode-backend triton \
+  --max-running-requests 256 \
+  --json-model-override-args '{"index_share_for_mtp_iteration":false}' \
+  --disable-custom-all-reduce --enable-fused-qk-norm-rope --enable-aiter-allreduce-fusion \
+  --reasoning-parser glm45 --tool-call-parser glm47 \
+  --enable-metrics --enable-cache-report --watchdog-timeout 3600 --skip-server-warmup \
+  --speculative-algorithm EAGLE --speculative-num-steps 5 \
+  --speculative-eagle-topk 1 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 6
+```
+
+**Decode (TP8 + DP-attention 8; TP4 / DP4 for the 4-GPU decode):**
+
+```bash Command
+python3 -m infera.engine.sglang \
+  --discovery-backend etcd --etcd-endpoint http://$ETCD_IP:2379 \
+  --advertise-host $NODE_IP --request-transport http --kv-event-transport zmq --kv-events off \
+  --no-enable-kv-events \
+  --model-path amd/GLM-5.2-MXFP4 --served-model-name amd/GLM-5.2-MXFP4 --trust-remote-code \
+  --host 0.0.0.0 --port 30100 \
+  --disaggregation-mode decode \
+  --disaggregation-transfer-backend mooncake \
+  --disaggregation-ib-device rdma0,rdma1,rdma2,rdma3,rdma4,rdma5,rdma6,rdma7 \
+  --tp-size 8 --dp-size 8 --enable-dp-attention --ep-size 1 \
+  --chunked-prefill-size 32768 --mem-fraction-static 0.92 \
+  --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 256 --tokenizer-worker-num 4 \
+  --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 --dsa-prefill-backend triton --dsa-decode-backend triton \
+  --max-running-requests 256 \
+  --json-model-override-args '{"index_share_for_mtp_iteration":false}' \
+  --disable-custom-all-reduce --enable-fused-qk-norm-rope --enable-aiter-allreduce-fusion \
+  --reasoning-parser glm45 --tool-call-parser glm47 \
+  --enable-metrics --enable-cache-report --watchdog-timeout 3600 --skip-server-warmup \
+  --speculative-algorithm EAGLE --speculative-num-steps 5 \
+  --speculative-eagle-topk 1 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 6
+```
+
+**Router** (OpenAI API on port 8000; `--decode-request-weight` per the table above):
+
+```bash Command
+python3 -m infera.server --router-backend rust \
+  --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 \
+  --discovery-backend etcd --etcd-endpoint http://$ETCD_IP:2379 \
+  --request-transport http --kv-event-transport zmq \
+  --router-tokenizer-path amd/GLM-5.2-MXFP4 --router-policy kv-aware \
+  --kv-prefill-overlap-weight 20 --kv-decode-overlap-weight 2 \
+  --session-affinity prefill --pd-prefill-guard-release completion \
+  --decode-input-demand on --decode-request-weight 1000000
+```
+
+Clients pass a session id in the `X-Session-ID` header so the router keeps a session's turns on the prefill worker that holds its prefix.
+
+Settings that matter on this deployment:
+
+- **`--disable-custom-all-reduce`.** With the AITER custom all-reduce on, decode output under DP attention with CUDA graphs is garbled.
+- **`--disable-overlap-schedule`** is required by pipeline parallelism on the prefill worker.
+- **`MC_MAX_MR_SIZE=1073741824`.** The ionic NIC rejects a 2 GiB dma-buf registration that starts 1 GiB-aligned; 1 GiB regions avoid it.
+- **HiCache sizing.** `--hicache-size 250` is per PP stage, so one prefill worker pins 1 TB of host memory for KV plus the DSA indexer's host pool (about 23% more). Releasing it after shutdown takes minutes; wait for it before restarting on the same node.
